source_refs.title: Add a site to my favorites in Microsoft Edge | Microsoft Support
source_refs.section: Add the current page to favorites
source_refs.verified_excerpt: Select the Add this page to favorites button in the address bar.
source_refs.model_visible_text: On Microsoft Edge: Open Microsoft Edge and go to the site you want to save. Select the button in the address bar that adds this site to favorites. If you want, rename the favorite. To choose a different folder, select it from the list. Then select **Done**.

source_refs.title: Create, find and edit bookmarks in Chrome - Android phone & tablet - Google Chrome Help
source_refs.section: Move a bookmark to a different folder
source_refs.applicability: Chrome on an Android phone or tablet
source_refs.verified_excerpt: Tap the folder where you want the bookmark.
source_refs.model_visible_text: On Chrome on Android: Open **Bookmarks** from the More menu. Find the bookmark, then tap the **More** icon to its right. Tap **Move to...**. Tap the folder where you want the bookmark. Tap **Move here**.
